children: Bhatt brings over 20 years of HR experience across Zydus, Aditya Birla Group, L&T, Café Coffee Day and Future Group

BDR Pharmaceuticals has appointed Niral Bhatt as its chief human resources officer, bringing an HR professional with more than two decades of experience across talent management, leadership development, employee engagement and business partnering. Bhatt joins the pharmaceutical company after more than 13 years with Zydus Group, where he held multiple HR leadership roles.
Bhatt spent more than 13 years at Zydus Group, most recently serving as general manager – HR from November 2022. Before that, he was deputy general manager – HR from April 2019 to October 2022.
His responsibilities during this period included capability building, compensation benchmarking, talent management, performance management, employee engagement and succession planning.

Bhatt also served as senior manager from April 2015 to April 2019 and HR manager from July 2013 to April 2015. His earlier responsibilities included employee lifecycle management, talent deployment and disciplinary processes.

Before joining Zydus Group, Bhatt worked as assistant manager – HR at Aditya Birla Group from April 2011 to July 2013. He was previously senior human resources officer at Larsen & Toubro from April 2010 to April 2011.

His earlier career included a stint as assistant manager – HR at Café Coffee Day from June 2008 to April 2010. He also worked as human resources executive at Future Group India from February 2006 to June 2008.

Bhatt began his career as an associate consultant at Academy of Human Excellence, where he worked from February 2004 to January 2005. He subsequently served as human resources executive at C. Mahendra Exports from January 2005 to February 2006.
His career has covered several areas of the HR function, including talent management, capability development, performance management, compensation, employee engagement and succession planning.
At BDR Pharmaceuticals, Bhatt will lead the human resources function, bringing experience from organisations across pharmaceuticals, consumer businesses, engineering and diversified groups.
The appointment adds an experienced HR leader to the company as it continues to build its people and organisational capabilities.
